shared_elements: low-relief figures arranged in horizontal registers/bands
schematic recurring signs/symbols (rectangles, H-like and hook shapes)
justification: Both surfaces carry schematic profile creatures (birds, quadrupeds) and abstract rectilinear signs cut in shallow relief and organised into horizontal bands, and both include serpentine linear elements. But A is a dense sequential text-like array of small uniform signs repeated in ruled lines, whereas B is a pictorial composition of a few large animals stacked one above another with a row of U-shaped motifs and a fringed band; the relationships (sequence of tiny signs vs. big animals confronting/superposed) are quite different.
